goals.title: Class XI pre-board and final examination readiness
goals.description: Prepare for December pre-boards and school finals expected between 17 February and 10 March 2027. Exact school paper dates are not yet known; use the official school date sheet to override the flexible final-exam blocks.

goals.title: SAT — 1600 target (March 2027 attempt)
goals.description:
Baseline from official Bluebook diagnostic: 1250 total (Reading & Writing 560, Math 690). Target 1600 (800 + 800). Prioritise Information and Ideas and Craft and Structure (both reported close to benchmark); maintain Expression of Ideas and Standard English Conventions (at/above benchmark). All four Math domains reported at/above benchmark; focus on hard Advanced Math, mixed reasoning, timing and zero careless errors. March 6 SAT is conditional on registration and no school-final conflict.

Official practice sources: Bluebook — https://satsuite.collegeboard.org/practice/practice-tests/bluebook ; Student Question Bank — https://satsuite.collegeboard.org/practice/student-question-bank ; Khan Academy — https://www.khanacademy.org/digital-sat

College Board 2027 March SAT details: March 6, 2027 (listed local start 7:45 AM); registration deadline February 19, 2027; late registration/change deadline February 23, 2027. Confirm the school-final date sheet and your admission ticket before relying on this date.

goals.title: AP Calculus BC — May 2027 exam readiness

achievements.title: Deep Work
achievements.description: Complete a single focus session of 2 hours.

achievements.title: Momentum Month
achievements.description: Complete 8 milestones within one calendar month.

achievements.title: Shipping Pace
achievements.description: Complete 15 milestones within one calendar month.

achievements.title: Plan Kept
achievements.description: Finish every planned block on 10 days.

achievements.title: Dependable
achievements.description: Complete 50 tasks on or before their due date.

achievements.title: Deadline Keeper
achievements.description: Complete 200 tasks on or before their due date.

achievements.title: Thirty Straight
achievements.description: Reach a 30-day streak on a single habit.

achievements.title: Broad Routine
achievements.description: Record a check-in on 5 different habits.

achievements.title: Weekends Count
achievements.description: Record activity on 20 separate Saturdays or Sundays.

achievements.title: No Weekend Gap
achievements.description: Record activity on both weekend days in 10 separate weeks.

achievements.title: Four Full Weeks
achievements.description: Record activity on all seven days in 4 separate weeks.

achievements.title: Twenty Full Weeks
achievements.description: Record activity on all seven days in 20 separate weeks.

achievements.title: Back to It
achievements.description: Rebuild a 5-day active run after a break of two or more idle days.

achievements.title: Resilient
achievements.description: Rebuild a 5-day active run after a break five separate times.

achievements.title: Time on Task
achievements.description: Record 25 hours of focused session time.

achievements.title: Hundred Hours
achievements.description: Record 100 hours of focused session time.

achievements.title: Five Hundred Hours
achievements.description: Record 500 hours of focused session time.

achievements.title: Hundred Sessions
achievements.description: Finish 100 timer sessions with recorded work time.

achievements.title: Early Start
achievements.description: Run 20 sessions of 15+ minutes starting before 07:00.

achievements.title: Late Shift
achievements.description: Run 20 sessions of 15+ minutes starting at or after 22:00.

achievements.title: Undisturbed
achievements.description: Finish 25 sessions of 25+ minutes with zero interruptions.

achievements.title: Four-Hour Day
achievements.description: Record 4 hours of focus within a single day.

achievements.title: Seven-Hour Day
achievements.description: Record 7 hours of focus within a single day.

achievements.title: Two Hours a Day
achievements.description: Record at least 2 hours of focus on 30 separate days.

achievements.title: Days as Planned
achievements.description: Finish 80% of planned minutes on 20 days with 3+ blocks scheduled.

achievements.title: Honest Estimates
achievements.description: Complete 25 tasks within 20% of their estimated time.

achievements.title: Calibrated
achievements.description: Complete 100 tasks within 20% of their estimated time.

achievements.title: Nothing Overdue
achievements.description: End 30 active days with no task left past its due date.

achievements.title: Clearing Day
achievements.description: Complete 12 tasks within a single day.

achievements.title: First Things First
achievements.description: Complete 50 tasks set at priority 4 or 5.

achievements.title: Right on Schedule
achievements.description: Complete 25 revisions on their due date.

achievements.title: Wide Recall
achievements.description: Complete at least one revision for 20 different plans.

achievements.title: Solid Recall
achievements.description: Grade 50 completed revisions at recall quality 4 or 5.

achievements.title: Upward Trend

achievements.title: Flawless Paper

achievements.title: Fewer Mistakes

achievements.title: Balanced Day
